comments.body:
Locally tested the one-line directory fix against current main (`c4420a4ef`) using real posthog-cli **0.19.0** and **0.15.1**. Ran all four cases against both the original and fixed scripts: **16 checks matched expectations**.

| Case | Original script | Fixed script |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `SOURCEMAP_FILE` unset | Uploads current map | Uploads current map |
| Explicit path inside `DERIVED_FILE_DIR` | Uploads current map | Uploads current map |
| External path containing spaces | Exits 1: no Hermes maps found | Uploads current map |
| External current map + stale map in `DERIVED_FILE_DIR` | **Uploads stale map and exits 0** | **Uploads only current map** |

The harness used synthetic packager/composed maps with distinct current/stale chunk IDs, the real CLI binaries, and a local mock API/storage server. Assertions checked clone metadata, the exact `--directory` argument, uploaded chunk IDs, file transfer, and upload finalization. The older CLI also exercised the existing default event-mode compatibility fallback without receiving the unsupported `--release-mode` flag.

This supports using `$(dirname "$SOURCEMAP_FILE")` deterministically rather than selecting a folder based on whether it contains maps: the latter risks silently uploading stale artifacts.

Scope: script-level validation, **not a full Xcode/EAS build**. Tested a temporary copy with only the proposed one-line change; no repository changes were made, and temporary files were cleaned up.
